step1_analysis.description: A full-bridge (H-bridge) output stage for a Class-D audio amplifier. It consists of two PMOS high-side and two NMOS low-side transistors that drive a differential load by switching the output nodes between the supply voltage and ground.

paper_reference.title: A 20-W Stereo Class-D Audio Output Power Stage in 0.6-m BCDMOS Technology

efficiency.description: Ratio of average power delivered to the load versus average power drawn from the supply.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Efficiency depends heavily on the ratio of load resistance to transistor on-resistance (Ron) and switching losses. With a 1k ohm load, conduction losses are minimized, yielding high efficiency.

output_power.description: Average power delivered to the differential load.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled down significantly from the paper due to the 1.8V supply of SKY130 and the use of a 1k ohm load to accommodate the small W/L (5um/0.5um) of the unscaled transistors.

switching_frequency.description: Frequency of the PWM input signal driving the gates.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard switching frequency range for Class-D audio amplifiers to push quantization noise out of the audio band.

rise_time.description: Time for the output node to transition from 20% to 80% of VDD.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the relatively high Ron of the W=5um transistors (~1k ohm) driving a 10pF load capacitance.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure output power, supply power, efficiency, and switching rise/fall times of the Class-D full-bridge output stage.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Class-D Output Stage Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N0 LABEL_NET_0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 LABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 LABEL_NET_3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 LABEL_NET_7 LABEL_NET_6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

* Supplies
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_6 LABEL_NET_6 0 1.8

* PWM Inputs (1MHz)
V_H1 LABEL_NET_7 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0 1n 1n 490n 1u)
V_L1 LABEL_NET_0 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0 1n 1n 490n 1u)
V_H2 LABEL_NET_2 0 PULSE(1.8 0 0 1n 1n 490n 1u)
V_L2 LABEL_NET_3 0 PULSE(1.8 0 0 1n 1n 490n 1u)

* Load
Rload N0 N1 1k
Cload N0 N1 10p

.control
tran 1n 5u

* Calculate instantaneous power
let p_load = (v(N0)-v(N1))*(v(N0)-v(N1))/1000
let p_vdd = (-i(VVDD) - i(VLABEL_NET_1) - i(VLABEL_NET_6))*1.8

* Measure average power and efficiency
meas tran p_load_avg avg p_load from=2u to=4u
meas tran p_vdd_avg avg p_vdd from=2u to=4u
let efficiency = p_load_avg / p_vdd_avg * 100
print p_load_avg p_vdd_avg efficiency

* Measure switching speeds
meas tran trise trig v(N0) val=0.36 rise=2 targ v(N0) val=1.44 rise=2
meas tran tfall trig v(N0) val=1.44 fall=2 targ v(N0) val=0.36 fall=2

quit
.endc
